IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: TO DELIVER EFFICIENT, COST-EFFECTIVE, AND QUALITY OPERATIONAL SERVICES TO NONPROFITS.
IRS990.MissionDesc: A NONPROFIT SOCIAL ENTERPRISE 501(C)(3) THAT PROVIDES STRATEGIC AND OPERATIONAL TOOLS FOR NONPROFITS TO GREATER IMPACT THE COMMUNITY.
IRS990.Desc: MANAGED SERVICES: MISSION EDGE PROVIDES COMPREHENSIVE MANAGED SERVICES SOLUTIONS FOR FUNDERS, NONPROFITS AND SOCIAL ENTERPRISES IN THE AREAS OF HUMAN RESOURCES AND FINANCE. MISSION EDGE'S PRODUCTS AND SERVICES INCREASE ORGANIZATIONAL EFFECTIVENESS VIA EXPERT SUPPORT FOR ESSENTIAL OPERATIONS AND BACK-OFFICE ACTIVITIES AND FACILITATES GREATER VISIBILITY INTO FINANCIAL RESULTS AND PROGRAM OUTCOMES TO EMPOWER ORGANIZATIONS TO DO MORE GOOD.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: FISCAL SPONSORSHIP IS A COST-EFFECTIVE WAY TO IMPLEMENT NEW PROGRAMS, BRING TOGETHER GROUPS TO COLLABORATE ON AN ISSUE, AND TEST NEW APPROACHES TO SOCIAL CHANGE. FISCAL SPONSORSHIP IS A COMMON MECHANISM USED IN THE NONPROFIT SECTOR THAT ENABLES INDIVIDUALS AND ORGANIZATIONS TO START NEW PROGRAMS WITHOUT ESTABLISHING A NEW, SEPARATE NONPROFIT ORGANIZATION. THESE FISCALLY SPONSORED PROJECTS GET THEIR CHARITABLE STATUS FROM THEIR FISCAL SPONSOR.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: MISSION EDGE FOLLOWS ACCOUNTING STANDARDS WHICH PROVIDE ACCOUNTING AND DISCLOSURE GUIDANCE ABOUT POSITIONS TAKEN BY AN ENTITY IN ITS TAX RETURNS THAT MIGHT BE UNCERTAIN. MANAGEMENT HAS CONSIDERED ITS TAX POSITION AND BELIEVES THAT ALL OF THE POSITIONS TAKEN IN ITS EXEMPT ORGANIZATION TAX RETURNS ARE MORE LIKELY THAN NOT TO BE SUSTAINED UPON EXAMINATION. AS OF DECEMBER 31, 2024, MISSION EDGE HAS NOT ACCRUED INTEREST OR PENALTIES RELATED TO UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS.

MISSION EDGE ISSUES GRANTS TO VARIOUS NONPROFITS AND FOR PROFITS IN THE U.S. UNDER ITS FISCAL SPONSORSHIP PROGRAM. MONITORING PROCEDURES INCLUDE REVIEW OF MONTHLY OR QUARTERLY FINANCIAL PROGRAM REPORTS AND SITE VISITS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: A DRAFT OF FORM 990 AND ALL SCHEDULES WILL BE REVIEWED BY THE AUDIT COMMITTEE, BOARD CHAIR, CEO, COO AND CONTROLLER OF FINANCE. ANY NECESSARY CHANGES WILL BE MADE. A FINAL VERSION WILL BE PROVIDED TO ALL DIRECTORS, AND THEN A FILING COPY WILL BE SIGNED BY THE CEO.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: EACH DIRECTOR, PRINCIPAL OFFICER, AND MEMBER OF A COMMITTEE WITH BOARD-DELEGATED POWERS OF THE ORGANIZATION ANNUALLY SIGNS A STATEMENT, WHICH AFFIRMS THAT SUCH PERSON HAS RECEIVED A COPY OF THE "CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY," HAS READ AND UNDERSTANDS THE POLICY, HAS AGREED TO COMPLY WITH THE POLICY, AND UNDERSTANDS THAT THE ORGANIZATION IS A CHARITABLE ORGANIZATION AND THAT IN ORDER TO MAINTAIN ITS FEDERAL TAX EXEMPTION STATUS, IT MUST ENGAGE PRIMARILY IN ACTIVITIES WHICH ACCOMPLISH ONE OR MORE OF ITS TAX-EXEMPT PURPOSES.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ALL COMPENSATION, INCLUDING SALARY, BENEFITS, AND OTHER COMPENSATION FOR THE CEO IS APPROVED BY THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF THE ORGANIZATION. THE BOARD CHAIR MAKES RECOMMENDATIONS TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS REGARDING THE CEO'S SALARY, BENEFITS, AND COMPENSATION BASED ON THE CEO'S PERFORMANCE, MARKET REVIEW, AND BUDGETARY CONSIDERATIONS. AN AFFIRMATIVE VOTE BY A MAJORITY OF THE BOARD MEMBERS PRESENT IS REQUIRED TO APPROVE THE RECOMMENDATION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ALL ITEMS ARE AVAILABLE ON REQUEST.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990 PARTS X, LINES 15 AND 32, AND PART XI LINE 4
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: DURING THE CURRENT YEAR, THE ORGANIZATION DISCOVERED A MATERIAL ERROR IN THE RECORDING OF IN-KIND CONTRIBUTIONS AS EXPENSES RATHER THAN AS ASSETS FOR THE UNUSED ITEMS. THIS RESULTED IN AN UNDERSTATEMENT OF ASSETS AND NET ASSETS WITH DONOR RESTRICTIONS. THE CORRECTION TO THIS ERROR HAS BEEN REFLECTED IN THE BALANCE SHEET BY RESTATING THE 2023 BALANCES BY INCREASING OTHER ASSETS BY $146,426 AND INCREASING NET ASSETS WITH DONOR RESTRICTIONS BY $146,426.
THERE WAS NO CHANGE DURING THE YEAR.
